Kubfu and Intense Training]]'' ({{pkmn|Adventures}}) }} A '''Master Dojo Student''' (Japanese: '''マスターどうじょうのもんかせい''' ''Master Dojo Disciple'') is a type of {{DL|Pokémon Trainer|Trainer class}} introduced in [[Generation VIII]]. They train in and assist with the [[Master Dojo]]'s trials across the [[Isle of Armor]]. Master Dojo Students are battled in the [[Towers of Two Fists]] during {{p|Kubfu}}'s training and in [[Restricted Sparring]]. Students in the Towers train Pokémon of their respective [[type]]; {{t|Dark}} types in the [[Tower of Darkness]] and {{t|Water}} types in the [[Tower of Waters]]. Master Dojo Students are the only opponents fought in Restricted Sparring, and unlike the player, can use a variety of types. ==Gallery== ===Models=== {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; {{roundy|20px}} border:2px solid #{{Isle of Armor color dark}}; background:#{{Isle of Armor color}}; font-size:80%" |- | style="{{roundy|20px}} border:2px solid #{{Isle of Armor color dark}}; background:#{{Isle of Armor color light}}" | [[File:VSMaster Dojo Student M.png|x100px]][[File:VSMaster Dojo Student F.png|x100px]] |- | colspan=2 | VS models from
